x: Carter again showed that he is a distinct acquisition, and his forward running gained him second prize in the handicap. Alec Traquair upheld the tradition of the "long markers" by taking first prize in the handicap, whilst third prize went to A.
Alec Traquair was rather unlucky to lose third place a few yards from home when Alec Robertshaw stole by him. The Field Events section had a Shot Putt Handicap, and here J.

Saunders, was second in the run, with Alec Traquair taking third place. Saunders, Shields, Taylor, and our Erith friends, Mains and Shaw, all showed up well and will be strong challengers for premier places in our teams and worthy representatives of the Club.
Congratulations also to Alec Traquair and Pat. Parker, upon the occasion of their recent weddings.
